[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Trophy Berserker Horn.jpg|150px]] }} [[Berserker Horn]]s are large horns from [[Minotaur]]s in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]]. Due to their size, some [[Norn]] use the horns on their helms. ==Acquisition== * [[Eye of the North]] ** [[Far Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Bjora Marches]], [[Jaga Moraine]], [[Varajar Fells]] **** [[Berserking Aurochs]] **** [[Berserking Bison]] **** [[Berserking Minotaur]] **** [[Berserking Wendigo]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== ;[[Bjora Marches]] [[File:Farming_Berserker_Horns_in_Bjora_Marches.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Berserker Horns in [[Bjora Marches]]]] Enter [[Bjora Marches]] from [[Longeye's Ledge]]. Following the route in the screenshot will take you from one group of minotaurs to the next. You can evade all other creatures, because there are barely any at all. There are on average 9 groups on the route. Groups consist of either 3 [[Berserking Bison]]s, 2 [[Berserking Wendigo]]s and 2 [[Berserking Minotaur]]s or 2 Berserking Wendigos and 1 [[Berserking Aurochs]]. The last group can pose a problem for some standard farming builds because of the strong healing from the Berserking Aurochs. Try to either [[spike]] it down first or disrupt its spellcasting if you are having trouble killing this group. Use [[Heart of the Norn]] for extra health. The average run yields about 7-8 Berserker Horns. ==Collectors== {{:Helming Baldbrow/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|11th April 2011 and 18th March 2013|Jaga Moraine |3 [[Berserker Horn]]s}}
